I found ten articles in `devto-articles` with Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4 as the main subject. All of them use the small Gemma 4 E2B model unless noted. The speed-up figures below are quoted from the article bodies.

#### The Tesla T4 series (vLLM on a Compute Engine VM)

1. **Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4: QAT Weights Decode 1.79x Faster Than bf16**: https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-qat-weights-decode-179x-faster-than-bf16-2fi4
   - Google's 4-bit QAT checkpoint against the full-precision bf16 model: 72.31 against 40.44 tok/s for one user, **1.79x**.
   - 215.91 against 164.62 tok/s at 8 users, **1.31x**.
   - With 4096-token prompts both builds sit at about 15–16 tok/s, so there is no gain there.

2. **Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4, Part 2: The Minimum GCE VM and a Script to Drive It**: https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-part-2-the-minimum-gce-vm-and-a-script-to-drive-it-3gk1
   - This one covers setup and gives no speed-up figure.

3. **Gemma 4 on a Tesla T4, Part 3: Int4 Embeddings Serve E2B in 2.86 GiB at 2.30x bf16**: https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-a-tesla-t4-part-3-int4-embeddings-serve-e2b-in-286-gib-at-230x-bf16-3kch
   - Packing the embedding tables to int4: 85.28 tok/s for one user, **2.30x bf16** and **1.37x** Google's QAT export.
   - At 8 users: 239.64 tok/s, **1.46x bf16** and **1.11x QAT**.
   - On 4096-token prompts the gain is only **3–7%**.
   - Google's drafter model (speculative decoding) adds **1.35x** with greedy decoding and **1.13x** with default sampling.

#### Other T4 articles

4. **Gemma 4 on Amazon SageMaker: The NVIDIA T4 Decodes at 0.8x of the L4 With the Same Answers**: https://dev.to/gde/gemma-4-on-amazon-sagemaker-the-nvidia-t4-decodes-at-08x-of-the-l4-with-the-same-answers-19m4 (also posted at https://dev.to/aws-builders/gemma-4-on-amazon-sagemaker-the-nvidia-t4-decodes-at-08x-of-the-l4-with-the-same-answers-hm7)
   - This is a slowdown compared with the L4: the T4 runs at **0.77x–0.82x** for one request.

   - E2B decodes at 108.5 tok/s.

   - Q5_K_M runs at 1.97x BF16 on the T4 and 2.15x on the L4.
   - Plain Q4_0 runs at 93.6 tok/s on the T4 against 87.8 for Google's QAT Q4_0.

8. **Four GPUs, One Quantization Ladder: Gemma 4 E2B From a 4 GB Laptop to an NVIDIA L4**: https://dev.to/gde/four-gpus-one-quantization-ladder-gemma-4-e2b-from-a-4-gb-laptop-to-an-nvidia-l4-4olp
